2609.11248.title: Generative Replay Mitigates Sample Starvation in Quantum Architecture Search
2609.11248.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can automate quantum architecture search, but its scalability is limited when useful circuit trajectories become rare in the rapidly expanding search space. Existing replay mechanisms reuse observed transitions; the proposed learned model produces additional predicted one step transitions from real state-action seeds. Here we introduce GenQAS, a tensor network-guided RL framework that combines a fixed matrix product state warm-start with prioritized generative replay. A learned local transition model generates synthetic circuit transitions on demand and mixes them with real experience during Double Deep Q-Network updates. Under a random exploration analysis, near ground state circuits occupy a rapidly shrinking region of the accessible state space. We investigate whether real data anchored synthetic replay can improve the effective training signal in this regime. Across chemical Hamiltonian benchmarks from 6 to 12 qubits, GenQAS improves fixed-budget success probability and identifies compact circuits at competitive energy error. At 12 qubits, it improves final success probability by up to $7.0\times$ over passive replay. On a 15-qubit transverse field Ising model, GenQAS increases success probability from $12\%$ to $21\%$. In a noisy 6-qubit BeH$_2$ transfer experiment, generative replay reduces the steps to chemical accuracy by $92.7\%$. These results show that generative replay can mitigate sample starvation in quantum architecture search and support more resource efficient circuit discovery.
2609.11248.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）可以自動化量子架構搜尋，但當有用的電路軌跡在快速擴展的搜尋空間中變得稀少時，其可擴展性受到限制。現有的重放機制重複使用觀察到的轉換；所提出的學習模型從真實的狀態-行動種子生成額外的預測一步轉換。在這裡，我們介紹GenQAS，一個由張量網絡指導的RL框架，結合固定矩陣乘積狀態的熱啟動和優先生成重放。一個學習的局部轉換模型按需生成合成電路轉換，並在雙深度Q網絡更新期間將其與真實經驗混合。在隨機探索分析下，接近基態的電路佔據了可訪問狀態空間中迅速縮小的區域。我們研究了是否以真實數據為基礎的合成重放可以改善這一範疇中的有效訓練信號。在6到12量子位的化學哈密頓基準中，GenQAS提高了固定預算的成功概率，並在競爭的能量誤差下識別出緊湊的電路。在12量子位時，它將最終成功概率提高了高達$7.0\times$，相較於被動重放。在15量子位的橫場伊辛模型中，GenQAS將成功概率從$12\%$提高到$21\%$。在一個嘈雜的6量子位BeH$_2$轉移實驗中，生成重放將達到化學準確性的步驟減少了$92.7\%$。這些結果顯示，生成重放可以減輕量子架構搜尋中的樣本匱乏，並支持更具資源效率的電路發現。
